app.source_strategy: V112 validated source artifact + V113 official-PDF patch
app.notes: Referência oficial verificada da APP V113. Não usar V90, V96 ou qualquer versão anterior como substituta para afirmar comportamento da V113. O fonte V113 é sintetizado pelo workflow a partir do artefato validado da V112 mais o patch oficial da V113.

site.pdf_behavior: movement detail remains view-only; bulk official PDF action now uses signed Storage URLs with attachment disposition. One selected PDF downloads by direct navigation; multiple selected PDFs open an explicit download list to avoid browser blocking artificial downloads. No site PDF generation or manual attach.
site.access_matrix_behavior: Admin sees the complete permission catalog and can edit every catalog permission for Manager, Supervisor and Operator with checkboxes; Admin remains full-access. Matrix saves through rca_admin_save_access_matrix_v118 and future catalog permissions are displayed automatically.
